description: Inspect Buzzsprout podcasts, episodes, and listener statistics.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Buzzsprout API token sent with the Authorization header. Get or reset it under Profile > API: https://www.buzzsprout.com/admin/profile/api.

actions.name: create_episode
actions.description: Create a Buzzsprout episode without uploading media.

publishedAt.description: The publication timestamp including a timezone offset.

explicit.description: Whether the episode contains explicit content.

private.description: Whether the episode is unpublished and private.

artworkUrl.description: A publicly accessible artwork URL that Buzzsprout should fetch.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Buzzsprout episode.

anyOf.description: The episode duration in seconds, or -1 while processing.

duration.description: The episode duration in seconds, or -1 while processing.

explicit.description: Whether the episode is marked as explicit.

private.description: Whether the episode is unpublished and private.

raw.description: The raw episode object returned by Buzzsprout.

outputSchema.description: The response returned after creating a Buzzsprout episode.

raw.description: The raw episode object returned by Buzzsprout.

actions.name: get_podcast
actions.description: Get one podcast available to the authenticated Buzzsprout account.

contactEmail.description: The podcast contact email when configured.

actions.name: list_episode_downloads
actions.description: List paginated download details for one episode and podcast-local date.

perPage.description: The maximum download records per page.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing episode download details.

anyOf.description: The ISO country code when available.

countryCode.description: The ISO country code when available.

anyOf.description: The next page number, or null when this is the last page.

nextPage.description: The next page number, or null when this is the last page.

outputSchema.description: The response returned for episode download details.

actions.name: list_podcast_downloads
actions.description: List per-episode download totals for one podcast-local date.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing podcast download totals.

total.description: The number of downloads on the requested date.

items.description: One episode's download total for a date.
